notes.title: Tech Demo Final Extension Week
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950971/9c15fef82d8734bc0ccda098707202f58eb9a53c.png[/img]

This is your last chance to experience the Blunderbusted public tech demo—extended for one more week! Dive into the world's first roguelike lightgun shooter (also playable with a mouse, Wii-mote, touchscreen, Steamdeck, etc.)

This is still a tech demo, so the full proper game loop is not quite in place, but there's still fun to be had and some OP stuff will show up in Baba Yaga's Shop of Corruption.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950971/78199055c36266d72d80e1b5b1af045b66970867.jpg[/img]

We're eager for your feedback to help shape the game's future! 

To continue testing and stay updated, join our Discord community:

[url=https://discord.gg/6FSzqXzBGq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950971/9f0208158943620f226dcbae81008cd94ab5e81c.png[/img][/url]

Don't miss out—see you in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950971/11fc9ebb8df3e6801e87c1df785f29c613faf56f.jpg[/img]
